items.name: Double Quarter Pounder® with Cheese Meal
items.description: Get double the fresh beef flavor with a Double Quarter Pounder® with Cheese made with fresh beef that’s cooked when you order. Served with our World Famous Fries® and your choice of an icy soft drink.
